grievance.title: Municipal Grievance Complaint Letter
grievance.body:
To,
[ENTER AUTHORITY]

Subject: [ENTER SUBJECT]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I, [ENTER NAME], residing at [ENTER ADDRESS], would like to draw your immediate attention to the following civic issue: [ENTER DETAILS].

Please look into the matter and take necessary corrective action at the earliest.

Thanking you,

Yours sincerely,
[ENTER NAME]

rti.title: Right to Information (RTI) Application Form A
rti.body:
To,
Public Information Officer,
[ENTER AUTHORITY]

Subject: Application under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005.

1. Name of the Applicant: [ENTER NAME]
2. Address: [ENTER ADDRESS]
3. Particulars of Information required:
   - Topic: [ENTER DETAILS]
   - Target Time Period: [ENTER PERIOD]
4. I state that the information sought does not fall within the restrictions contained in Section 8 and 9 of the RTI Act and to the best of my knowledge it pertains to your office.

Date:
Place:

Signature of Applicant:
[ENTER NAME]

general.body:

[ENTER AUTHORITY]

legal.body:
